metadata.title: India-Sri Lanka International Maritime Boundary Line (IMBL)
metadata.source: Treaty texts 1974 and 1976 (UN DOALOS copies); cross-checked against Marine Regions v12
metadata.note: Positions at sea are fixed by joint survey under the treaties; this line is for safety awareness and modelling, not navigation.
